answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The vertex edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 140 clones produces a signature the crystal analysis flags immediately. Someone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the sonnet settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
